project_title: ZenPinball AI - Custom Arcade Table Engine
archetype: Electric Neon Arcade & Tactical Precision (Dark Mode Pinball Cabinet)

layout_strategy.mode: Mode A: Tetris Bento Grid with Dedicated Pinball Cabinet Stage

cabinet_structure.backglass_dmd: Glassmorphic overlay with animated LED dot-matrix score, current target mission, combo multipliers, tilt warning
cabinet_structure.playfield_canvas: 2D Physics Canvas wrapped in illuminated 1px neon tracing beam border with glossy glass reflection overlay
cabinet_structure.touch_controls: Dual tactile flipper buttons (Left/Right) with haptic feedback & spring-loaded Plunger drag lever on mobile/touch

sidebar_drawers.theme_generator: Instant AI Theme Prompt box with quick preset pills (Cyberpunk Odyssey, Galactic Odyssey, Haunted Mansion, Neon Synthwave, Jurassic Safari)
sidebar_drawers.table_editor: Tabbed parameters: Physics (Gravity, Elasticity, Flipper Torque), Art & Backglass (Cabinet theme, dynamic playfield tint, photo-realistic art mode switch), Mission Rules (Target combo multiplier, Extra ball threshold), Brand Assets (Uploaded logo/icon texture selector)
sidebar_drawers.saved_library: Grid of saved custom tables with thumbnail previews, play count, high score, edit & delete controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Always maintain dark arcade theme with vibrant neon highlights (#FF007A, #00F0FF, #FFB800).
Ensure all interactive components (flipper buttons, prompt inputs, play buttons, sliders, delete actions) contain explicit 'data-testid' attributes.
Implement canvas-based 2D pinball physics with realistic flippers, ball bounce, bumpers with particle burst FX, slingshots, lane targets, ramps, plunger spring pull, and multiball support.
Ensure complete responsive layout with prominent touch flipper buttons for mobile devices and keyboard controls (Left/Right Arrows, Spacebar for Plunger).
Provide dynamic AI table generation based on user theme prompts (custom bumper layouts, color palettes, backglass art, target values, ambient synth sound effects/synth audio cues).
Support saving, editing parameters (gravity, colors, flipper power, backglass title/tagline, scoring rules), loading, and deleting saved tables from a persistent store/localStorage.
Support brand asset upload library for custom logos/icons on bumpers or backglass.
Never use generic centered transparent overlays — use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur and 1px crisp borders.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='play-table-btn', data-testid='left-flipper-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use explicit transitions like 'transition-colors duration-200' instead of 'transition-all'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: All text must meet high APCA contrast ratios against #08090E and dark surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.sonner_toasts: Use sonner for toast notifications when tables are saved, edited, or deleted.
